name: ERIC API
summary: Search the ERIC education research database (journal articles, reports) over a free keyless JSON API.
description: ERIC indexes education literature with titles, abstracts, authors, subjects, publication dates and full-text availability. The API supports Solr-style queries and returns JSON (or XML). At check time a query for reading returned 166,792 matching records.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in what was checked.

license.name: U.S. government publication; see ERIC terms

agent_notes: Use search=field:"term" Solr syntax; rows and start page the results. Response content-type is text/plain although the body is JSON.
caveats: Content-type is text/plain; parse the body as JSON anyway.
Licensing text and page limits were not verified today.
The eric.ed.gov docs page sits behind a bot-defence script that returned no readable text to curl.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
